CustomField.label: Is Field Membership
CustomField.description: Whether an edge of this type represents an owning-object-to-its-own-field relationship (e.g. HAS_FIELD) rather than a real cross-entity relationship. The Graph Canvas uses this flag — never a hardcoded edge typeKey check — to absorb the target field into the source object's Schema-Builder-style card (GraphUI.md §20 addendum) instead of rendering it as a separate node/line, and to re-anchor any other edge touching that field onto its owning object so relationship lines always connect object to object.
